segments.normalizedSource: ```swift // Overload the ~= operator to match a string with an integer. func ~= (pattern: String, value: Int) -> Bool { return pattern == "\(value)" } switch point { case ("0", "0"): print("(0, 0) is at the origin.") default: print("The point is at (\(point.0), \(point.1)).") } // Prints "The point is at (1, 2)." ```
